verdict.rationale: The evidence documents Calendly only as an MCP server, exposing its scheduling tools to external AI apps. That is the opposite role and earns no credit here. Nothing shows Calendly or its Callie assistant can connect to or consume third-party MCP servers. The axis is still a fair question for a SaaS product with a built-in AI assistant, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
